facts.fact: Elise 把猎人、持矛随从、父亲和他的贵族聚起来，带回 Isen 去的那个山谷
facts.anchor: rallying them back to the valley where Isen had gone

facts.fact: Isen 的尸体不完整：左腿扭烂，一条手臂断落在几步外的草地上
facts.anchor: One arm was gone. It lay some distance from him amongst the green

facts.fact: Egil 爬上土坡，眼睛圆睁、被恐惧弄死了一般；Elise 抱住他，父亲同时号哭
facts.anchor: Egil scrabbled up over the bank

facts.fact: 队伍把黑王子抬回城堡，没有号角与欢呼，Faoldun 的居民沉默地看着
facts.anchor: they were silent as they witnessed the incoming parade of death

facts.fact: 尸体被抬进河边的冷屋，放在山羊与猪的尸体之间洗身
facts.anchor: amid the corpses of goats and pigs

facts.fact: Ysel 拿鞣皮针把王子的断臂小心缝回去
facts.anchor: began to reattach the prince’s arm

facts.fact: Tilde 否认是林中魔法，说森林没有自己的意志；又否认叛军把 Isen 引进峡谷
facts.anchor: The forest doesn’t have a will of its own

facts.fact: 楼梯上 Tilde 握住 Elise 的手腕吻上去，随后转身下楼去见国王
facts.anchor: Tilde held her wrist to her warm lips
